title: Bunny dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#f5f0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='16' fill='#f5f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='16' rx='6' ry='17' fill='#f5f0ff' transform='rotate(-12 40 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='16' rx='3' ry='13' fill='#ffc2d8' transform='rotate(-12 40 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='16' rx='6' ry='17' fill='#f5f0ff' transform='rotate(12 60 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='16' rx='3' ry='13' fill='#ffc2d8' transform='rotate(12 60 16)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='3' fill='#7a4fd0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='3' fill='#7a4fd0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='1' fill='#e8dcff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='1' fill='#e8dcff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#ff98bc'/>
  <path d='M50 47 Q47 51 44 49 M50 47 Q53 51 56 49' fill='none' stroke='#c9a8e0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ffc2d8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ffc2d8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <path d='M34 62 Q24 54 22 44' fill='none' stroke='#f5f0ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 62 Q24 54 22 44' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='0 1000'/>
  <path d='M66 62 Q76 54 78 44' fill='none' stroke='#f5f0ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#f5f0ff' transform='rotate(-15 40 88)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-15 40 88)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#f5f0ff' transform='rotate(15 60 88)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(15 60 88)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='76' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='76' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#d8c8f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd54a'>
    <circle cx='18' cy='26' r='3'/>
    <rect x='20' y='14' width='2' height='12'/>
    <path d='M22 14 Q28 15 27 20' fill='none' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='34' r='3'/>
    <rect x='84' y='22' width='2' height='12'/>
    <path d='M86 22 Q92 23 91 28' fill='none' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
